rule_or_pattern: Drop every line with width_ratio > 0.6 (wider than one column), on all pages regardless of detected page_n_columns (e.g. random 5 is on a page detected as 1 column). The print is two-column throughout.
notes: This is an 1869 two-column session record in the test split. Single-column lines (width_ratio ~0.47-0.50: 1, 2, 9, 13, 16-19) read correctly. All full-width lines are two columns joined across the '|' gutter (3, 5-8, 10-12, 14, 15, 20-40), and several of them carry a label from elsewhere: 24's crop is 'Κατὰ τὴν λῆξιν…' but its label is 'τὸ ὑπουργεῖον'; 22, 25 and 30 are likewise mismatched. Line 5 has no crossing flag (its page was detected as 1 column), so a width rule is safer than the gutter rule alone. The ς-for-στ ligature readings (2 'ὥσε', 35 'γνωςή', 39 'γιςος') are left to the pool-wide στ rule.
